core_obligations: Diagonal of a monomorphism: the diagonal of a monomorphism of algebraic stacks is an isomorphism (proof lines 1165-1167)
An isomorphism of algebraic spaces is proper and unramified, which is exactly separatedness and DM-ness of the morphism (proof lines 1168-1170)
Immersions are monomorphisms, so the second assertion follows from the first (proof lines 1171-1173)
proof_roadmap: 单态射的 Δ_f 是同构（跨章指针）；而代数空间的同构既 proper 又 unramified。
按「分离 = Δ proper」「DM = Δ unramified」即得第一句。
浸入是单态射（跨章指针），故第二句由第一句即得。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a monomorphism of algebraic stacks is separated and DM, and that the same holds for immersions (author lemma at source lines 1158-1162, label lemma-monomorphism-separated). The proof (source lines 1164-1173) observes that the diagonal of a monomorphism is an isomorphism, that an isomorphism of algebraic spaces is proper and unramified, and reads off separatedness and DM-ness from the definitions, with the immersion case reduced to the monomorphism case (proof lines 1165-1173). The identification of the diagonal and the reading of the two properties off it are the content. H2.
